mechanisms.note: Four synchronised hydraulic telescopic rams in the bronze posts at (±3.0, ±1.35); ≈ 22 t. Ease-in-out as a jerk-limited S-curve: a ≤ 0.70 m/s², jerk ≤ 1.2 m/s³, cruise 0.791 m/s. Rim channel 0→1 over 1.0 s as built (PondLift.cpp:209), lengths lit in order from the west apex clockwise; it drops to 0 on landing. One use toggles (Down→open, Up→close); no use while moving. Uses only from the oval floor (not over the opening when Up). Auto-close when the visitor is on level 0 more than 16.0 from the centre. The guard holds, never reverses. Interlock: the last 0.10 of descent waits for nympheas.guard-rails housed.

The three rails round the open well (§3.6) rise 0 → 1.00 m as the pond passes 0.10 → 1.10 m of its 2.6 m, and are housed before the pond's last 0.10 of descent. Driven by the pond's channel, never used directly.

The lowest stage (Ø 0.210) of the four telescopic rams (§3.5). A single-acting telescopic ram extends its largest stage first, since the pump's pressure lifts the load soonest on the largest area; each stage strokes a third of the pond's 2.6 m (0.867 of its 0.95, leaving 0.083 ≥ the 0.08 overlap in the sleeve). It carries the two stages nested in it, and stops once out. The pond's own guard sweeps the posts' columns.
The middle stage (Ø 0.180): it rides out with the lowest stage over the pond's first third, then strokes out of it over the second, 0.083 of it kept inside.
The ram (Ø 0.150), its head under the tray: it rises with the pond the whole way, stroking out of the middle stage over the last third.
